note: Original game-map imagery for an independent game reference. Community archives identify the imagery as the in-game map and the world screenshot. Source records describe provenance, not a license grant. The viewer, controls, labels and directory integration are independently implemented; no competitor viewer, watermark or site code is copied.

coordinateData.correction: Preserved 243 source place indices of -1 as unassigned; the old importer incorrectly mapped them to the last place. Stable point IDs derive from source build, coordinates, type index and place index; duplicate source rows use occurrence suffixes.

serviceMarkers.note: Separately sourced named service/event references from public map markup, not a one-to-one extension of the object snapshot. Counts describe references, not guaranteed unique in-game objects.

regionalMarkers.note: Only name, type, source identifier and coordinates are used. The viewer and text are independently implemented.

records.relation: Explicit building-level links only; no invented individual-point correspondence.

world.method: Independently placed region-reference pins at visible district labels on the 1200×594 world screenshot. No live ownership or settlement pins.
